title: Cuisipro Stainless Steel Cheese Grater with Handle, 4 Sided Box Grater for Kitchen, Ginger Grater Dishwasher Safe, Fruit and Vegetables Slicer, Cheese Shredder for Potato, Chocolate, Parmesan, Ginger
description:
About this item
Multi Purpose Grater with Ginger Shredder Base: Having four different grating surfaces, this 4 sided cheese grater helps you grate the fruit and vegetables into the size as you wish, from fine to coarse; With a detachable base, you can not only use it as a ginger shredder but also use it integrating with the grater, acting like a built-in container
Ergonomic Design with Large Capacity: By using the patended surface glide techonology, the Cuisipro box grater brings you a smooth grating enjoyment; Compared to the traditional handheld ones, this multifunctional box grater with a non slip handle is able to grate more food at a time, more effort saving and time saving
Dishwasher Safe 304 Stainless Steel Design: Adopting the stainless steel makes the food shredder more durable; Compared to the traditional plastic vegetable grater, this stainless steel box grater is allowed to cleaned by dishwasher, saving more time and effort
Be Your Own Master Chef: With this sophisticated and versatile grater, you no longer need to worry about your pre-cook skill, which affects the beauty and taste of the food; Even without knife, you can still slice the fruit and vegetables by using this Cuisipro slicer
